unmatched.text: This world is not my home, I’m just a-passing through. My treasures are laid up
I and the church with which I am connected are in full communion with the Mahoning Baptist Association, and through them with the whole Baptist society.
To an Independent Baptist,

Style no man on earth your Father: for he alone is your Father who is in heaven; and all ye are brethren. Assume not the title of Rabbi; for ye have only One Teacher: neither assume the title of Leader; for ye have only One Leader—the Messiah.

It shall have for its object the developement, and introduction of that political and religious order of society called THE MILLENNIUM, which will be the consummation of that ultimate amelioration of society proposed in the Christian Scriptures.
that the world may believe.
Our wisdom is to be always ready.
Let Christians shew by their peaceful, holy lives, that his laws are sufficient to govern the whole world in peace and love.
Reflections of Old Age,
In doing this they were clearing away the rubbish from the foundation of God’s government of the world.
We expect no new Sun, no new revelation of the Spirit, no other than the same gospel and the same religion, only that it shall be disinterred from the rubbish of the dark ages
Prefatory Remarks,
our best political institutions we can part with without a tear or a sigh, when Jesus reigns on earth, and has placed a throne in every heart and built a temple in every family.
The Bible begins with the generations of the heavens and the earth; but the christian revelation ends with the regenerations, or new creation of the heavens and the earth
God recreates, regenerates, but annihilates nothing; and, therefore, the present earth is not to be annihilated.

John saw the New Jerusalem, the holy city, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride for her husband, to locate in the new earth, the everlasting home of man; for the tabernacle of God is to be there forever.
The Coming of the Lord—No. II,
For man he made this planet, and all the tenantry thereof. And for him he has promised to create a new earth out of this earth, and a new heaven out of this heaven
The notion, so very prevalent, that the Christian’s future home lies away in some immeasurably distant region, is only a vulgar error
God built this earth for man, and he does not intend to be defeated in his purpose.
A Theory of the Millennium,

Beat your swords into ploughshares, your spears into pruning-hooks; convert your war-ships into missionary packets, your arsenals and munitions of war into Bibles, school-books, and all the appliances of literature, science and art
I pray—for those who shall believe on me through their teaching, that all may be one
that the world may believe that thou hast sent me
Foundation of Christian Union,
1st. Nothing is essential to the conversion of the world but the union and co-operation of christians. 2nd. Nothing is essential to the union of christians but the apostles teaching or testimony.
the union of christians, and the destruction of sects, are indispensable prerequisites to the subjection of the world to the government of Jesus
While the Army of the Faith is enlisted under so many different generals
they may make havoc upon one another, but it is impossible they can convert the world.
Let the unity of Christians be our polar star
that the world may believe, and be saved
But let that man, who opposes Christian union, remember, that he opposes the prayer of Jesus, and the salvation of the world.
Some of you say it will be effected in the millenium. No, it must be effected before, that the world may be brought to believe and be saved.
And are we not all looking for a Millennium of universal peace and prosperity
? These things being so, our grand concern and present duty is, to adopt the proper means for accomplishing this truly blissful and desirable object.
The kingdom of heaven is divided into small societies, called churches, or congregations of the Lord.
Would not the same effect be now produced, if the same means were used? Certainly; for this is the very order of heaven.
The Responsibility of the Church to God,
We are so sanguine (perhaps many will say, so visionary) as to imagine that a nucleus has been formed, or may be formed, around which may one day congregate all the children of God.
Who that thinks of heaven, of eternal peace and love, can refrain from pleading the union, concert, and co-operation of all the sincere followers of the Lamb of God?

When then we see a people making new divisions and keeping up old ones, while praying for the Millennium or the triumph of love and harmony, we as naturally suspect that they are any thing but in earnest.
We do not ask them to give up their opinions—We ask them only not to impose them upon others.
who has made all the citizens of his kingdom, not citizens only, but citizen kings and priests to God.

Being a royal priesthood, all children of a King, they have a right to meet in his name to break the loaf of blessing, to drink the cup of blessing, without the intervention of a mediator, priest, or prophet, consecrated by human hands.
’Tis here, and here alone, that the king and the beggar meet on one platform and stand on equal ground before God, angels and demons.
the emancipation of all the world from faith in, and obedience to, any set of men, titled and enthroned as they may be, as the representatives or successors of the apostles of Christ.
The Everlasting Gospel
our religion was destined
to cancel all orders of nobility in the state and in the church
and finally to restore the long-lost liberties of mankind.

In detecting the false gospels, nothing will aid us so much as an examination of their tendencies, and a comparison of their effects with what the Millennium proposes. The gospel of no sect can convert the world.
To see even a few scores of intelligent christians
meeting around one and the same Lord’s table, and uniting in the praises and adorations of one and the same common Lord and Saviour, imparts to us a joy which we are unable to express.
Prefatory Remarks,
immersion, I mean Christian immersion, is the gospel in water, and that the Lord’s supper is the gospel in bread and wine.
Ancient Gospel No. II,

the original impulse of the Stone-Campbell Movement stressed the metaphor of table rather than altar. As a consequence, early traditions emphasized the role of Jesus as host at the table and the joy of table fellowship.
The Lord’s Supper as Eschatological Table
In the afternoon, we had heaven upon earth; that is, we had the Lord’s Supper.
We already eat at the eschatological table of the Lord; we already sit at the table with Jesus in his kingdom.
The Lord’s Supper as Eschatological Table
The Lord’s day not only commemorates the resurrection of Jesus, but anticipates the morning of the resurrection in which we shall enter into the rest which remains for the people of God.
a deepening gloom overspreads our ecclesiastical heavens
with what caution we have spoken on the prophecies and millennial matters
We had more pressing and important matter on hand
terminate in schism
Modesty sits most gracefully on
interpreters of prophecy
Alexander Campbell was a postmillennialist. James A. Harding was a premillennialist. Walter Scott changed his mind several times. David Lipscomb was uncertain.
What Will Become of the Earth: A Nashville Bible School Perspective
However, these all agreed that the most important aspect of the Christ’s second coming was the regeneration not only of the soul, but the body and the whole cosmos.
What Will Become of the Earth: A Nashville Bible School Perspective
it was the dominant perspective among churches of Christ in the late nineteenth century
What Will Become of the Earth: A Nashville Bible School Perspective
Biblical faith, according to Lipscomb and Harding, is lived as if the future is already present, as if the heavenly city has already been planted on the earth.
Extending the Kingdom Theology of Lipscomb and Harding
We confidently thought that the Millennium was just at hand
In this we were wholly mistaken.
The Jews were very wrong in their ideas of Messiah’s first coming; so may we be of his second.—Our wisdom is to be always ready.
We believe he came once, and we are pardoned; we hope he will come again, and we shall be glorified!
which even of our great men so urges the hope of the gospel upon the brethren as to purify them by it?
to mingle and mould them into one universal brotherhood, to break in pieces and destroy all earthly kingdoms and dominions, and fill the whole earth and stand forever.
the kingdom of God as the ark of safety will ride the sea of fire, bearing all committed to its keeping into the new heavens and to the new earth wherein dwelleth righteousness.
the earth is God’s nursery, his training grounds
Then God will take up his abode himself with his great family upon this new, this renovated and purified earth.
For What Are We Here?
Personally I believe in the pre-millennial coming of our Lord
but do I think them any less Christian
In this great gathering I see a prophecy of that which is to be when all of God’s people, of every race and clime, shall sit down together.
That place that God has intended should be a type of heaven, men, by covetousness, hatred, strife, adultery and backbiting, have made the pit of hell.
Negro Evangelization,

all the Millennium we could scripturally expect was not merely the restoration of the Jerusalem church in all its moral and religious characters, but the extension of it through all nations and languages for one thousand years.
Millennial Character of the Harbinger,
Most of the Bible does not consist of rules and regulations—lists of commands to be obeyed. Nor does it consist of creeds—lists of things to be believed.
How Can the Bible Be Authoritative?

Story authority, as Jesus knew only too well, is the authority that really works. Throw a rule book at people’s head, or offer them a list of doctrines, and they can duck or avoid it, or simply disagree and go away. Tell them a story, though, and you invite them to come into a different world
How Can the Bible Be Authoritative?
The Bible, in fact, is not simply an authoritative description of a saving plan, as though it were just an aerial photograph of a particular piece of landscape. It is part of the saving plan itself.
And that is the task of the whole church. Need I say, not merely of the professional caste within it
How Can the Bible Be Authoritative?

At no point do the resurrection narratives in the four Gospels say, ‘Jesus has been raised, therefore we are all going to heaven.’ It says that Christ is coming here, to join together the heavens and the Earth in an act of new creation.
to think of the vocation of the church as the call to live as the small working model of new creation.
The bread and the wine can be seen as true gifts coming forward to us from God’s future
We are presented, close up and personally, with new creation that we can eat and drink.
